Doc 75, Phase 3: each mark's targets from the calibration runs (tools/steer_calibrate.py): G (m_g_day) left of the centre, S (m_upper_share) right of it, both at the centre, as the mean of days 120-365 of the run at that mark, the band 2 standard deviations of its 28-day mean there (at least 0.01 in G, 1 point in S); hungerMost and shortMost the table's; tills the run's tills short; floor_from the run whose seasonal treasury profile gives the mark's floor. A half mark's target is halfway between the centre's and the end's; its band, tills and floor are the half-mark run's.
